user.title: Choose ABB Welcome device type
user.description: Choose **Web-admin IP gateway** for an ABB 83342/MRANGE gateway with a local web admin. Choose **App-managed indoor station** for an M2240x/ASI22 Wi-Fi station or an IP touch panel paired through the MyBuildings/Welcome app.

credentials.title: ABB Welcome credentials
credentials.description: Enter the credentials required for the selected {profile} profile. App-managed devices are checked on SIP-TLS port 5061 and use no gateway admin password. Leave Gateway Portal UUID blank to pick the device from your MyBuildings account.{discovered_devices}{debug_report}

manual_authorize.title: Approve pairing on the gateway
manual_authorize.description:
Auto-approval failed, but the pairing request was sent successfully and is waiting on your gateway. Please finish the approval manually:

1. Open https://{gateway_ip}/ in a browser and log in as `admin`.
2. Navigate to the **Portal / Portal Client** page.
3. Find the pending app named:

    **{client_name}**

4. When prompted for an integrity code, enter:

    **{integrity_code}**

5. Confirm / Approve in the gateway UI.
6. Click **Submit** below to continue.

Home Assistant will wait up to 5 minutes for the gateway to confirm the pairing.{debug_report}

app_authorize.title: Waiting for the device

pending_pairing.title: Recover unfinished pairing

discard_pending_pairing.title: Discard saved pairing?
discard_pending_pairing.description: This permanently forgets the saved Home Assistant key and certificate. The associated client cannot be recovered afterward. First remove or unpair that client from the official Welcome app/client management and MyBuildings, then click **Submit** to confirm.

pending_pairing_invalid.title: Saved pairing cannot be recovered
pending_pairing_invalid.description: The saved pending identity is unreadable or from an unsupported storage version. Its contents have not been logged. Remove the orphaned Home Assistant client from the official Welcome app/client management and MyBuildings, then click **Submit** to clear the unusable state and start again.

progress.pairing_certificate: Requesting a client certificate from MyBuildings…
progress.pairing_discovery: Looking up the device on your MyBuildings account…
progress.pairing_connect: Sending the pairing request to the gateway through MyBuildings…
progress.pairing_approve: Approving the pairing request in the gateway web admin…

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the gateway web admin on HTTPS port 443. Check the IP address and that Home Assistant is on the same network.
error.sip_tls_unavailable: Cannot reach SIP-TLS port 5061 on the app-managed device. Check the IP address, device Wi-Fi, and network routing.
error.gateway_admin_auth_failed: Gateway admin password is wrong (login at https://gateway-ip/ as `admin` failed).
error.gateway_web_admin_missing: This device has no IP gateway web admin (its login page returned 404), so the web-admin device type cannot pair with it. That device type supports the 83342 IP gateway only.
error.no_pending_app: The gateway did not see our pairing request. Try again or check that the portal account is linked to this gateway.
error.integrity_code_rejected: The gateway rejected the integrity code we computed. Open an issue with your gateway firmware version.
error.gateway_admin_failed: Talking to the gateway admin CGI failed. See the debug report below.
error.gateway_op6_failed: Neither the gateway nor MyBuildings reported this gateway's portal UUID. Fill in the optional 'Gateway Portal UUID' field and try again.
error.invalid_uuid: Gateway Portal UUID must look like 8d24f178-9c41-4aed-97e1-6008bb6aef82 (8-4-4-4-12 hex). Leave blank to auto-detect.
error.invalid_profile: Choose one of the supported device types.
error.acl_timeout_retry: No configuration arrived from the device yet.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. See the debug report below.
error.resend_failed: The pairing request could not be sent again. See the debug report below.
error.device_not_found: No IP gateway or Wi-Fi indoor station is visible to this MyBuildings account. Enter the device's Gateway Portal UUID, or check that the device belongs to this account.
error.device_choice_required: Several devices belong to this MyBuildings account. Enter the Gateway Portal UUID of the one to pair from the list above.
error.invalid_dtmf_code: Use up to 16 DTMF characters: 0-9, A-D, * and #.

abort.acl_timeout: The gateway did not push a configuration after pairing. Try again.{debug_report}
abort.acl_parse_failed: The gateway sent a configuration but it could not be parsed.{debug_report}
abort.pending_storage_failed: Home Assistant could not securely save or clear the pending pairing identity. No new pairing should be started; check the Home Assistant storage/log state.{debug_report}
abort.acl_revoked: The device rejected this Home Assistant client. Start setup again; for an app-managed device, choose Discard to create a new client.{debug_report}
abort.client_rejected: MyBuildings no longer accepts this Home Assistant client; it may have been removed. Start setup again; for an app-managed device, choose Discard to create a new client.{debug_report}
abort.saved_device_not_listed: The saved pairing targets a device that is not on this MyBuildings account. Start setup again, choose Discard, and enter the Gateway Portal UUID of the device to pair.{discovered_devices}{debug_report}

init.title: ABB Welcome options
init.description: Door unlock behavior and the LAN RTSP endpoint used by Scrypted/HomeKit. On app-managed devices, Hybrid requires the physical panel default door to be selected explicitly. Home Assistant cannot discover this setting. A lock with an opener code ignores the unlock strategy.

data.default_unlock_station_id: Physical default door for Hybrid fast path
data.lan_rtsp_proxy: Serve camera streams to the LAN over RTSP (Scrypted/HomeKit)
data.lan_rtsp_host: Advertised Home Assistant LAN host (blank = auto)
data.preview_before_answer: Preview a ringing call without answering (talking answers it)
data.ring_video_size: Video size taken from a ringing station
data.camera_still_image: Show the last station screenshot as the camera still image

error.fast_multi_door_unsupported: Fast cannot safely target a specific door on an app-managed device with multiple doors. Use Standard, or Hybrid with the physical default door selected.
error.invalid_default_unlock_station: Select the door configured as the physical indoor panel default before enabling Hybrid.
error.invalid_dtmf_code: Use up to 16 DTMF characters: 0-9, A-D, * and #.

options.app_managed: App-managed indoor station (M2240x / ASI22, IP touch)

options.hybrid: Hybrid (app-managed physical default; web-admin first door)
options.fast: Fast (always plain MESSAGE) — lowest latency, may not work everywhere
